systems.system: Programme de digitalisation des communes et villes camerounaises (PDCV) commune web platforms
systems.owner: Communes et villes unies du Cameroun (CVUC), with a 1.5 billion FCFA presidential grant; presented under MINDDEVEL
systems.tiers: 374 platforms planned in phase 1 (360 communes, 14 urban communities); 335 communes with a .cm website as of 11 September 2025

note: The programme puts communes' planning and management tools online, civil status being named once as an example; the article describes websites and says nothing of how a birth or death is registered.
